summary: Smith Feutrill is a Hawthorn VIC accounting and financial services firm led by four directors with a team of over 40. Ed Beasley was promoted to Principal from 1 January 2026 as director Greg Feutrill steps back to part time. The firm sells virtual CFO advisory and back office support covering bookkeeping, trust accounting, accounts management and payroll.
